source_changes.summary: Adds public single-token OpenCL layer request/result structs, a runtime availability probe, and the shared single-token forward function for C5 parity dispatch.

Factors the existing OpenCL layer body into a loaded-values helper, derives q/k norm widths from tensor vectors, adds the OpenCL runtime probe, and exposes a single-token wrapper that pads to the existing kernel execution shape.

Loads manifest-backed layer-0 tensors for OpenCL parity only after CPU body success and runtime availability, dispatches the shared OpenCL single-token forward path, and fails closed on runtime absence, dispatch error, shape mismatch, nonfinite output, or CPU/GPU mismatch.
Updates local host expectations to the precise OpenCL runtime-unavailable fail-closed field while preserving no-prediction behavior and prior schema/tokenizer/tensor rejection guards.
